Brand System and Product Data Migration for a Growing Retailer

E-commerce Retailer · Confidential

the challenge

The client was moving off a templated storefront onto a custom build, but their existing brand identity was generic enough to be mistaken for any other store in the category — and the product catalog migration risked losing structured data (variants, dimensions, metafields) that the old platform stored inconsistently.

our approach

We treated the brand and the migration as one problem, not two: the new visual system needed to be distinctive enough to justify the platform move, and the data migration needed to preserve everything that made the catalog usable. We defined a full creative direction — typography, layout logic, and motion language — before writing a line of migration code, so the new site wasn't just technically correct but visually differentiated.

what we built

A complete brand system (typography pairing, layout grid, interaction language) and a Python migration script moving 84 products across platforms, pulling structured variant and dimension data through the source platform's GraphQL API rather than re-entering it by hand.

the outcome

The catalog moved over cleanly with zero manual re-entry, and the new brand direction gave the client a storefront that reads as their own rather than a template — with dimension-data reconnection scoped as a fast follow-up rather than a blocker to launch.
